allowed_closed_development_data: Q2 V4.1 31-controller item-level binary error profiles on the frozen 300-item CRUXEval panel
Q2 OOS V2 16-controller item-level binary error profiles on the same frozen panel
the historically collected baseline profile only after protocol comparability is verified
frozen controller coefficient vectors and A0/A1/A2 descriptors
closed validity, evaluability, generated-token, and runtime metadata
prompt text and deterministic structural features only where benchmark licensing permits local analysis

source_compatibility_gate.baseline_special_rule: Baseline may enter only if its generation and scoring protocol is directly comparable; otherwise it remains a descriptive external control.

eligibility: no model-output generation under a candidate Q3 policy
canonical order fixed without reference use

policy_population.candidate_identity: controller identity plus shell; baseline is a distinct optional policy
policy_population.same_direction_rule: At most one shell from a controller may appear in a bank.
policy_population.shell_selection_rule: Within each training partition, retain the shell with higher mean binary correctness; ties break by higher evaluability, then lower mean generated tokens, then MEDIUM.

policy_bank_rules.A0_MAXIMIN: Deterministic farthest-point selection in frozen A0 geometry; first policy is the competence-qualified medoid; later ties break lexicographically.
policy_bank_rules.A2_MAXIMIN: Same deterministic rule using equal-shell-average A2.
policy_bank_rules.ACCURACY_QUALIFIED_A0_MAXIMIN: Training-only eligibility requires accuracy >= max(0.50, training champion accuracy - 0.10), commitment validity >= training baseline - 0.05, and evaluability >= training baseline - 0.05; then apply A0 maximin.
policy_bank_rules.RANDOM_PLANNING: One thousand deterministic random banks per K using seed 2026090403; planning distribution only.
policy_bank_rules.OUTCOME_ORACLE: Training/test outcome-optimized coverage upper bound only; never an eligible deployable bank.

routing_mechanisms_in_precedence_order.name: ONE_CALL_PRE_GENERATION_ROUTER
models: regularized bilinear phi(x)^T W c_k with policy bias
low-capacity nonlinear geometry-aware model with one hidden layer of at most 16 units

routing_mechanisms_in_precedence_order.name: BUDGETED_BASELINE_FIRST_ADAPTIVE_POLICY
routing_mechanisms_in_precedence_order.open_only_if: Route A fails the frozen feasibility criteria

routing_mechanisms_in_precedence_order.name: VERIFIER_MEDIATED_COMMITTEE
routing_mechanisms_in_precedence_order.open_only_if: Routes A and B fail the frozen feasibility criteria

available_without_new_model_inference: Python AST node and control-flow proxy counts without execution
prompt length and tokenizer-free character statistics
forbidden: item ID as a predictive feature

nested_cross_fitting.allocation: SHA-256(item_family_id || q3-realizable-utility-v1) modulo fold count, with deterministic balancing by hash rank if any fold differs by more than one
nested_cross_fitting.rollout_handling: Average two rollout correctness indicators within item-policy for estimation; retain item/family as the uncertainty unit.

utility_definitions.one_call_budget: one selected-policy generation per item; any separate label-free feature forward is counted as prefill-equivalent compute
utility_definitions.multi_call_requirement: Must beat a credible repeated-baseline or self-consistency control at equal expected generations and token budget.

primary_inference_candidates.primary_test: one-sided paired permutation/randomization test on item-level correctness differences, with exact enumeration when feasible and deterministic Monte Carlo otherwise
primary_inference_candidates.confidence_interval: paired family-level nonparametric bootstrap calibrated prospectively by simulation; percentile interpretation allowed only if calibration passes
primary_inference_candidates.multiplicity: One frozen primary Route-versus-champion contrast; other controls are secondary with Holm correction within their declared family.
primary_inference_candidates.missingness: Missing scheduled output blocks completion; it is not imputed.
primary_inference_candidates.stochastic_rollouts: Future lock must freeze R; paired analysis averages all frozen rollouts within item-policy before testing.

power_simulation.selection_rule: Smallest eligible N with >=0.80 power at 3 percentage points under the empirically plausible development discordance scenario and no less than 0.80 under the prespecified conservative discordance=0.20 scenario.

prohibitions: No closed development analysis becomes Q3 evidence.
No future holdout outcome may be inspected or used in this task.
No method may be selected because it gives a favorable future outcome.
No oracle selector may be described as realizable utility.
No Q1 or Q2 classification may be changed.
